5 tips for making great animations for 2D games

App Store Optimization (ASO): A/B Testing Screenshots to Improve Installs

In order to stay on top of your app store optimization, you need to manage it constantly. Having the best screenshots is a must and this guide tells you how to get them. If you’re not sure what makes the best screenshot, then find out how to choose them wtih A/B testing.

5 Mobile Games That Design for Monetization

For most developers, monetization comes after the fact. In this post from Chartboost, find out how the top games built their game on top of their monetization strategy. Understanding the two-step approach to mobile user acquisition

News

Windows 10 Mobile is coming to Windows Phone devices in December

The big news this week regarding Windows was the announcement of some new Lumia devices. More importantly for developers was the announcement that Windows 10 Mobile is coming to devices before the end of the year. Not all devices will be able to get the new OS in December but Microsoft has confirmed it as the start date for Windows 10 roll-out.

Apple Approves An App That Blocks Ads In Native Apps, Including Apple News

The advent of adblocking software for iOS devices will mean significant changes for the mobile landscape. Not only will you be able to block ads in your mobile browser, “Been Choice” will block ads in native apps as well. This new app is set to disrupt monetization practices for a lot of developers. Big players are no exception, with ads also being blocked in Apple and Facebook apps too.

Apple reportedly buys secretive deep learning startup Perceptio

Apple has made a number of acquisitions lately in a very dedicated niche. A few days after purchasing VocalIQ, an artificial intelligence startup, Apple are reported to have bought Perceptio, a deep learning startup. Maybe Siri is getting an upgrade or Apple don’t want this technology going to a competitor, only time will tell.
